pages.title: The Ledge Villa
pages.text: Suspended above the mountain ridge, The Ledge Villa combines modern luxury with Costa Rica’s raw natural beauty. Designed for privacy and comfort, this villa features an open-concept layout with a king-size bed, a fully equipped kitchen, and a spa-inspired bathroom with soaking tub. Floor-to-ceiling windows open to a screened porch with mountain views, while the upper balcony offers sweeping vistas of both the ocean and mountains. Outdoors, guests can enjoy a shaded terrace facing the private infinity pool, surrounded by lush gardens and the property’s plantations. A walk-in closet and versatile sleeping options make this villa ideal for couples, families, or small groups seeking a serene yet elevated retreat. Book now Guests enjoy an open studio-style villa with flexible sleeping arrangements (1 king or 2 twin beds), a fully equipped kitchen, spa-style bath with tub, screened porch, covered poolside terrace, ocean- and mountain-view balcony, private infinity pool, walk-in closet, private parking, and access to surrounding gardens, plantations, and trails.

pages.title: The Retreat House
pages.text: With stunning mountain and ocean views, you experience luxury unlike any other. THE RETREAT HOUSE This luxurious studio is the perfect escape for honeymooners, couples, or solo travelers looking for peace, romance, and inspiration. Just 15 minutes from Sámara’s beaches, this villa blends modern luxury with rustic charm. The private infinity pool, open-concept spa bathroom, and unique cordwood wall design make it a truly unforgettable retreat surrounded by the sights and sounds of Costa Rica. Amenities “ We had the best stay. Such a beautiful, special place. We spent hours just relaxing and watching the view. Lots of grounds to explore, we walked down to the river on the property, had a fire at the view point and my children loved the pool and the beautiful swing under the trees. Thank you so much for having us! HELENA Guest

pages.title: Mountain House
pages.text: With stunning mountain and ocean views, you experience luxury unlike any other. THE MAIN HOUSE This fabulous house is nestled in the mountains, only 15 minutes from the beaches of Samara, and it is the definition of a peaceful retreat. Come here to be alone and write your novel, relax, or to spend quality time as a family. Situated on 20 acres of private land, filled with a variety of fruit trees (coffee, chili peppers, star fruit, plantains, lime, and more) you will experience the natural beauty of Costa Rica immersed in the sights and sounds of nature. pages.title: About Us
pages.text: The Retreat at Blue Mountain Farms The Retreat is a serene getaway nestled in the mountains near Chinampas, Guanacaste, Costa Rica, just a short drive from vibrant Samara Beach. Our resort offers comfortable accommodations, sustainable farming, and activities designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. At The Retreat, we welcome diverse travelers—from nature enthusiasts and wellness seekers to families seeking a peaceful retreat. Our cozy houses and villas feature modern amenities and picturesque mountain views. Sustainability is central to our ethos. We cultivate our own fruits, vegetables, and coffee using eco-friendly methods on-site. Guests enjoy fresh, organic produce during their stay and can purchase these items to take home. In addition to accommodations and dining, The Retreat offers a variety of activities. Our guided tours explore local farms, coffee plantations, and provide insights into Costa Rican culture. The gift shop features locally crafted souvenirs, and our coffee shop offers a relaxing space to enjoy Costa Rican hospitality. The Retreat is a place to unwind, reconnect with nature, and appreciate Costa Rica's natural beauty. Whether seeking adventure or relaxation, our resort offers a chance to experience the charm of Costa Rica's mountains in a peaceful and welcoming environment. Come and discover The Retreat—where every moment invites you to escape, explore, and embrace the tranquility of Costa Rica's mountainous landscape.
